span.p:
Every service uses:
- Hystrix circuit breaker for all downstream calls
- Separate thread pools per dependency (bulkhead)
- Stateless design (no local session state)
- Health checks on /health endpoint every 10 seconds
- Rolling deploys (10% at a time, 5 min monitoring)
